name: WZML-X Mirror Leech Bot
description: Feature-enhanced Mirror/Leech Telegram Bot with support for various download sources and cloud storage.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID of the bot owner.

TELEGRAM_API.description: Telegram API ID obtained from https://my.telegram.org.

TELEGRAM_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash obtained from https://my.telegram.org.

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB connection URL for persistent storage.

CMD_SUFFIX.description: Suffix appended to all bot commands.

AUTHORIZED_CHATS.description: Space-separated list of chat IDs authorized to use the bot.

SUDO_USERS.description: Space-separated list of user IDs with sudo privileges.

USER_SESSION_STRING.description: Pyrogram user session string for premium features.

DEFAULT_UPLOAD.description: Default upload destination: 'gd' for Google Drive or 'rc' for Rclone.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of the bot's web server (e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com) used for torrent file selection.

BASE_URL_PORT.description: Port for the web server. Leave unset on Heroku — the PORT environment variable is automatically assigned to web dynos and takes precedence.

UPSTREAM_REPO.description: GitHub repository URL to pull updates from on bot startup.

UPSTREAM_BRANCH.description: Branch of the upstream repository to pull updates from.

GDRIVE_ID.description: Google Drive folder or Team Drive ID for uploads.

INDEX_URL.description: Index URL for Google Drive file indexing.

IS_TEAM_DRIVE.description: Set to 'true' if GDRIVE_ID is a Team/Shared Drive.

RCLONE_PATH.description: Default Rclone remote path for uploads.

RCLONE_SERVE_URL.description: Public URL used for Rclone serve.

LEECH_DUMP_CHAT.description: Telegram chat ID for leech dump.

RSS_CHAT.description: Telegram chat ID for RSS feed notifications.

RSS_DELAY.description: Delay in seconds between RSS feed checks.

STATUS_UPDATE_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds for task status message updates.

STATUS_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of tasks shown in the status message.
